title: GitHub - leog/ai-pulse: Ambient macOS light strip for AI coding agents — a Dock-adjacent pill of eight LEDs showing whether anything is working, waiting, finished, or broken
excerpt: Ambient macOS light strip for AI coding agents — a Dock-adjacent pill of eight LEDs showing whether anything is working, waiting, finished, or broken - leog/ai-pulse
content_html:
An ambient macOS light strip for AI coding agents, inspired by the SidePulse hardware gadget — but as an app. A slim strip of eight virtual LEDs floats in the unused space beside the Dock and shows, with a single aggregate signal and no per-model distinction, whether anything is running, waiting for you, finished, or broken:

Reduce Motion replaces every animation with a static treatment. The original per-agent icon pill remains available via Settings → Appearance → Indicator style.

AI Pulse is not embedded in the Dock — macOS exposes no public API for Dock accessories. It is a Dock-adjacent, borderless, nonactivating NSPanel positioned from public screen geometry (NSScreen.frame vs visibleFrame). No private APIs, no Accessibility/Screen Recording permissions, no injection.

Install

Grab AI-Pulse-<version>.zip from the latest release, unzip, move AI Pulse.app to /Applications, and launch. Releases are not yet notarized, so on first launch right-click the app → Open (on macOS 15+, also allow it under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway). The aipulse CLI ships inside the bundle at AI Pulse.app/Contents/Helpers/aipulse.

Releases are cut automatically when a PR merges: patch by default, minor or major when the PR carries a release:minor / release:major label.

Requirements (building from source)

  • macOS 14+
  • Xcode 16+ / Swift 6 toolchain

Build, test, run

swift build                         # build everything (app, CLI, kit)
swift test                          # unit + integration tests (AIPulseKit)
swift run AIPulseApp                 # launch the pill (accessory app: no Dock icon)
swift run AIPulseApp --snapshot DIR  # render pill + hover card PNGs headlessly and exit
swift run aipulse health             # CLI: check the local event service
./Scripts/make-app.sh               # assemble + sign dist/AI Pulse.app
./Scripts/make-gifs.sh              # regenerate docs/ GIFs from headless frames (needs ffmpeg)

docs/pulse-social.gif is a larger, captioned cut of the same state cycle, made for sharing.

For day-to-day use, run the bundled app rather than the bare binary: the script signs it with your Apple Development identity, giving a stable code signature so the Keychain trusts the app across rebuilds (bare swift run binaries are ad-hoc signed and trigger a Keychain consent prompt after every rebuild — that is also why AIPULSE_DEV_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN=1 exists for dev loops). The CLI is embedded at AI Pulse.app/Contents/Helpers/aipulse.

(The app product is AIPulseApp because AIPulse and the aipulse CLI would collide on case-insensitive filesystems.)

Publishing agent status

AI Pulse listens on 127.0.0.1:7455 (configurable in Settings). On launch it stores a bearer token in the Keychain and writes ~/Library/Application Support/AIPulse/cli.json (mode 0600) so the aipulse CLI authenticates without tokens ever appearing in shell commands:

aipulse agent upsert \
  --id "claude-code:$PWD:$SESSION_ID" \
  --name "Claude Code" --provider anthropic \
  --instance "$(basename "$PWD")" \
  --state working --message "Implementing Dock placement"

aipulse agent update \
  --id "claude-code:$PWD:$SESSION_ID" \
  --state waitingForInput --message "Waiting for permission" --sequence 2

aipulse agent remove --id "claude-code:$PWD:$SESSION_ID"
aipulse agents        # list everything the pill knows

Endpoints: POST /v1/agents/upsert, POST /v1/agents/{id}/event, DELETE /v1/agents/{id}, GET /v1/agents, GET /v1/health (health is the only unauthenticated route). The server binds to the loopback interface only, caps request sizes, validates every payload (AgentReducer + RequestValidator), rejects unsafe URL schemes, and never executes anything received in an event.

Dev note: rebuilding the app changes its ad-hoc code signature, so Keychain reads re-prompt per build; launch with AIPULSE_DEV_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN=1 during development to skip the Keychain and use a per-run token instead.

Quit via the pill's right-click menu → Quit AI Pulse (or kill the process).

Structure

  • Sources/AIPulseKit — AppKit-free, fully unit-tested core:
    • Domain/ — Agent, AgentState, AgentAction (typed safe actions + URL scheme allowlist), AgentEventPayload (wire model), AgentIntegrationLevel, StatusPriority (urgency sort).
    • Store/AgentStore — single source of truth; all surfaces render from it.
    • Placement/ — ScreenSnapshot, best-effort DockGeometry inference, pure PlacementPolicy (gutter → adjacent → corner fallbacks, clamping).
  • Sources/AIPulse — the app:
    • Presentation/Pill/ — nonactivating AIPulsePanel, SwiftUI capsule, per-state icons (glyph + badge + ring, never color alone), hover card.
    • Presentation/AgentList/, Presentation/Settings/ — conventional keyboard-accessible windows.
    • Placement/DockPlacementController — debounced screen-change observation; no polling.

Status

Milestones 1–3 are complete:

  • M1 — nonactivating panel, pill UI, mock agents, hover card, context menu.

  • M2 — bottom/left/right Dock placement, multi-display selection with a Settings display picker, debounced screen/space-change observation, off-screen clamping, opt-in auto-hidden-Dock following (best-effort, from the Dock's public preference domain — read-only, no Dock interaction).

  • M3 — AgentReducer event normalization (versioning, ID validation, sequence/timestamp ordering, duplicate rejection, safe-action mapping), centralized StalenessPolicy (working agents stale after a configurable silence, then demoted to disconnected after a longer one; agents whose backing process has exited are demoted within one sweep via a PID liveness check; completed agents expire after a configurable delay; waiting, approval, and failed states never expire on timers), and persistence to ~/Library/Application Support/AIPulse/agents.json with restart restore: unresolved attention states come back as-is, live-only states come back as disconnected until their source reports again.

  • M4 — loopback-only HTTP event service (LocalHTTPServer), Keychain bearer token + 0600 handshake file for the CLI, transport validation, the aipulse publisher CLI, and end-to-end integration tests. Verified live: CLI → HTTP → reducer → store → pill in ~150 ms round-trip.

  • M5 — Claude Code adapter (ClaudeCodeAdapter + aipulse claude-hook), built against the documented hook lifecycle: SessionStart→idle, UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse→working, PermissionRequest and permission-prompt Notifications→approvalRequired, idle-prompt Notifications→waitingForInput, Stop→completed, StopFailure→failed, SessionEnd→removed. One pill entry per session per project. Prompt text, tool inputs, and assistant output are never decoded, so they can never be published. The hook always exits 0 and prints nothing.

  • M6 — optional dynamic Dock icon (off by default; Settings → Appearance). Aggregates the same AgentStore snapshot as the pill via DockTileAggregator: failure > attention > working > neutral, with an NSDockTile custom content view for the state treatment and badgeLabel showing the count of unacknowledged urgent agents. The floating pill and the Dock icon are independently toggleable; the icon never bounces.

All six MVP milestones are complete, followed by the pivot to the lights-first presentation (LightAggregator + LightStripView), keeping the icon pill as an option.

Claude Code integration

This repository ships .claude/settings.json registering aipulse claude-hook for the relevant hook events (via the debug build path), so Claude Code sessions in this repo appear in the pill automatically once the app is running. For system-wide use:

swift build -c release
sudo cp .build/release/aipulse /usr/local/bin/

then register the same hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json, replacing the command with plain aipulse claude-hook. Claude Code asks you to approve project hooks the first time it loads them.

Privacy

AI Pulse displays status sent by local agent integrations. It does not read prompts, terminal contents, editor contents, or application windows.

Contributing

Contributions are welcome — see CONTRIBUTING.md for the project's design principles, testing expectations, and how to add a new agent integration. docs/DEBUGGING.md covers the debugging surface: environment variables, headless snapshots, log streaming, on-disk state, and fixes for the common failure modes.

License

MIT

blocks.html_en: • M3 — AgentReducer event normalization (versioning, ID validation, sequence/timestamp ordering, duplicate rejection, safe-action mapping), centralized StalenessPolicy (working agents stale after a configurable silence, then demoted to disconnected after a longer one; agents whose backing process has exited are demoted within one sweep via a PID liveness check; completed agents expire after a configurable delay; waiting, approval, and failed states never expire on timers), and persistence to ~/Library/Application Support/AIPulse/agents.json with restart restore: unresolved attention states come back as-is, live-only states come back as disconnected until their source reports again.

content_html_zh:
用于 AI 编码代理的 macOS 环境光带，灵感来自 SidePulse 硬件小工具 - 但作为一个应用程序。 一条由八个虚拟 LED 组成的细长条漂浮在 Dock 旁边未使用的空间中，并通过单个聚合信号显示，并且没有按型号区分，是否有任何内容正在运行、正在等待您、已完成或已损坏：

减少运动用静态处理替换每个动画。 原始的每个代理图标药丸仍然可以通过“设置”→“外观”→“指示器样式”使用。

AI Pulse 未嵌入 Dock 中 - macOS 未公开 Dock 配件的公共 API。 它是一个与 Dock 相邻、无边框、非激活的 NSPanel，定位于公共屏幕几何图形（NSScreen.frame 与visibleFrame）。 没有私有 API，没有辅助功能/屏幕录制权限，没有注入。

安装

从最新版本中获取 AI-Pulse-<版本>.zip，解压缩，将 AI Pulse.app 移动到 /Applications，然后启动。 版本尚未经过公证，因此首次启动时右键单击应用程序 → 打开（在 macOS 15+ 上，也可以在系统设置 → 隐私和安全 → 无论如何打开下允许它）。 aipulse CLI 包含在 AI Pulse.app/Contents/Helpers/aipulse 的捆绑包中。

当 PR 合并时，版本会自动删除：默认情况下是补丁，当 PR 带有release:minor /release:major 标签时，版本是次要的或主要的。

要求（从源代码构建）

  • macOS 14+
  • Xcode 16+ / Swift 6 工具链

构建、测试、运行

swift build                         # build everything (app, CLI, kit)
swift test                          # unit + integration tests (AIPulseKit)
swift run AIPulseApp                 # launch the pill (accessory app: no Dock icon)
swift run AIPulseApp --snapshot DIR  # render pill + hover card PNGs headlessly and exit
swift run aipulse health             # CLI: check the local event service
./Scripts/make-app.sh               # assemble + sign dist/AI Pulse.app
./Scripts/make-gifs.sh              # regenerate docs/ GIFs from headless frames (needs ffmpeg)

docs/pulse-social.gif 是同一状态周期的更大的、带标题的剪辑，用于共享。

对于日常使用，运行捆绑的应用程序而不是裸露的二进制文件：脚本使用您的 Apple 开发身份对其进行签名，提供稳定的代码签名，以便 Keychain 在重建过程中信任该应用程序（裸露的 swift 运行二进制文件是临时签名的，并在每次重建后触发 Keychain 同意提示 - 这也是开发循环中存在 AIPULSE_DEV_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN=1 的原因）。 CLI 嵌入在 AI Pulse.app/Contents/Helpers/aipulse 中。

（该应用程序产品是 AIPulseApp，因为 AIPulse 和 aipulse CLI 会在不区分大小写的文件系统上发生冲突。）

出版代理状态

AI Pulse 监听 127.0.0.1:7455（可在“设置”中配置）。 启动时，它会在钥匙串中存储不记名令牌并写入 ~/Library/Application Support/AIPulse/cli.json （模式 0600），以便 aipulse CLI 进行身份验证，而令牌不会出现在 shell 命令中：

aipulse agent upsert \
  --id "claude-code:$PWD:$SESSION_ID" \
  --name "Claude Code" --provider anthropic \
  --instance "$(basename "$PWD")" \
  --state working --message "Implementing Dock placement"

aipulse agent update \
  --id "claude-code:$PWD:$SESSION_ID" \
  --state waitingForInput --message "Waiting for permission" --sequence 2

aipulse agent remove --id "claude-code:$PWD:$SESSION_ID"
aipulse agents        # list everything the pill knows

端点：POST /v1/agents/upsert、POST /v1/agents/{id}/event、DELETE /v1/agents/{id}、GET /v1/agents、GET /v1/health（health 是唯一未经身份验证的路由）。 服务器仅绑定到环回接口，限制请求大小，验证每个有效负载（AgentReducer + RequestValidator），拒绝不安全的 URL 方案，并且从不执​​行在事件中收到的任何内容。

开发说明：重建应用程序会更改其临时代码签名，因此钥匙串会在每次构建时重新读取提示；在开发过程中使用 AIPULSE_DEV_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN=1 启动，以跳过钥匙串并使用每次运行令牌。

通过药丸的右键菜单退出→退出 AI Pulse（或终止进程）。

结构

  • Sources/AIPulseKit — 无需 AppKit、经过完全单元测试的核心：Domain/ — Agent、AgentState、AgentAction（键入的安全操作 + URL 方案白名单）、AgentEventPayload（线路模型）、AgentIntegrationLevel、StatusPriority（紧急排序）。 Store/AgentStore — 单一事实来源；所有表面均由其渲染。 Placement/ — 屏幕快照、尽力而为的 DockGeometry 推理、纯 PlacementPolicy（装订线 → 相邻 → 角后备、夹紧）。
  • Sources/AIPulse — 应用程序：Presentation/Pill/ — 非激活 AIPulsePanel、SwiftUI 胶囊、每个状态图标（字形 + 徽章 + 环，从不单独使用颜色）、悬停卡。 Presentation/AgentList/、Presentation/Settings/ — 传统的键盘可访问窗口。 Placement/DockPlacementController — 去抖屏幕变化观察；没有投票。

地位

里程碑 1-3 已完成：

  • M1 — 非激活面板、药丸 UI、模拟代理、悬停卡、上下文菜单。
  • M2 — 底部/左/右 Dock 放置、使用设置显示选择器进行多显示器选择、去抖动屏幕/空间变化观察、离屏夹紧、选择自动隐藏 Dock 跟随（尽力而为，来自 Dock 的公共偏好域 - 只读，无 Dock 交互）。
  • M3 - AgentReducer 事件规范化（版本控制、ID 验证、序列/时间戳排序、重复拒绝、安全操作映射）、集中式 StalenessPolicy（工作代理在可配置的静默后过时，然后在更长的静默后降级为断开连接；支持进程已退出的代理通过 PID 活跃度检查在一次扫描内降级；已完成的代理在可配置的延迟后过期；等待、批准和失败状态在计时器上永远不会过期）和持久性~/Library/Application Support/AIPulse/agents.json 并重新启动恢复：未解决的关注状态按原样返回，仅实时状态以断开连接状态返回，直到其源再次报告。
  • M4 — 仅环回 HTTP 事件服务 (LocalHTTPServer)、用于 CLI 的钥匙串承载令牌 + 0600 握手文件、传输验证、aipulse 发布者 CLI 和端到端集成测试。 实时验证：CLI→HTTP→reducer→store→pill，往返时间约为 150 毫秒。
  • M5 - Claude Code 适配器（ClaudeCodeAdapter + aipulse claude-hook），根据记录的钩子生命周期构建：SessionStart→idle、UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse→working、PermissionRequest 和权限提示通知→approvalRequired、idle-prompt notifications→waitingForInput、Stop→completed、StopFailure→failed、SessionEnd→removed。 每个项目每次会话一粒药。 提示文本、工具输入和助手输出永远不会被解码，因此它们永远不会被发布。 钩子总是退出 0 并且不打印任何内容。
  • M6 — 可选的动态 Dock 图标（默认关闭；设置 → 外观）。 通过 DockTileAggregator 聚合与药丸相同的 AgentStore 快照：失败 > 关注 > 工作 > 中立，并使用 NSDockTile 自定义内容视图进行状态处理，并使用 badderLabel 显示未确认的紧急代理的数量。 浮动药丸和 Dock 图标可独立切换；图标永远不会弹起。

所有六个 MVP 里程碑均已完成，接下来是转向灯光优先演示（LightAggregator + LightStripView），并保留图标药丸作为选项。

克劳德代码集成

此存储库附带 .claude/settings.json，为相关挂钩事件注册 aipulse claude-hook（通过调试构建路径），因此一旦应用程序运行，此存储库中的 Claude 代码会话就会自动出现在 Pill 中。 对于系统范围的使用：

swift build -c release
sudo cp .build/release/aipulse /usr/local/bin/

然后在 ~/.claude/settings.json 中注册相同的钩子，用普通的 aipulse claude-hook 替换命令。 Claude Code 会在第一次加载项目挂钩时要求您批准它们。

隐私

AI Pulse 显示本地代理集成发送的状态。 它不读取提示、终端内容、编辑器内容或应用程序窗口。
